ownerDecision: The product owner confirmed the interaction candidate fully meets expectations; for this T048 refinement the repository-local HTML is the accepted low-fidelity carrier. High-fidelity and production visual acceptance remain pending.

decisionsRepresented.versionActions: Each row has a visible three-dot menu for Mark/Unmark and Delete; Preview and Restore stay in a persistent selected-version detail area.
decisionsRepresented.repeatedMark: An unchanged scene reuses its existing marked version, gives live feedback, and focuses/scrolls to that version; a simulated scene change permits a new snapshot.
decisionsRepresented.currentDrawing: Shown separately from saved history rows; no row is inferred to be current.
decisionsRepresented.longList: Long list button adds 42 rows to exercise scrolling while the selected target and primary actions remain fixed.

keyboard: Tab reaches version selection and per-row actions; menu supports ArrowUp/ArrowDown and Escape; confirmation supports Escape, Cancel-default focus, and a two-control focus loop; Ctrl/Cmd+M marks current, Ctrl/Cmd+E simulates a canvas change.
scope: Interaction and grayscale layout discussion only. Not production UI, implementation evidence, or high-fidelity approval.
